verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so serving LoRA adapters is a fair question for it. The evidence covers only local LoRA fine-tuning (training), model conversion and OpenAI-compatible APIs. Nothing documents loading, hot-swapping or efficiently serving multiple LoRA adapters on one base model, and fine-tuning is an adjacent capability that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
